findings.defect: The draft changes 식경 to shichen. A sikgyeong is roughly thirty minutes, while a shichen is roughly two hours.
findings.rationale: The source specifies 식경, so the current rendering substantially changes the elapsed time.
findings.source: 한 식경 전에 그들이 탄 장강수로맹의 쾌조선이 출항했습니다.

findings.current: [^1]: A shichen was a traditional two-hour period.
findings.defect: The footnote defines the wrong traditional time unit and therefore reinforces the draft’s incorrect timing.
findings.rationale: The source uses 식경, not 시진.
findings.replacement: [^1]: A sikgyeong was the time required to eat a meal, conventionally treated as roughly thirty minutes.

findings.current: The Sichuan Governor had been born into a powerful family that had produced three Grand Councilors and had walked a smooth road throughout his life.
findings.defect: The draft reads 삼공 as a quantity of three officials. Here 삼공 is the collective title for the highest ministerial offices, so the source does not state that the family produced exactly three Grand Councilors.
findings.rationale: Removing the invented numerical claim preserves both the family’s political stature and the institutional reference.
findings.replacement: The Sichuan Governor had been born into a powerful family that had produced Grand Councilors, and his path through life had always been smooth.
findings.source: 삼공(三公)을 배출한 세도가의 핏줄로 태어나 탄탄대로를 걸어온 사천성주다.

findings.current: Everything was proceeding exactly as she—or rather, that person—desired.
findings.defect: “That person” loses the reverential hierarchy encoded by 그분, weakening the reveal that the concubine is acting under a superior power while the superior’s identity remains unstated.
findings.rationale: The self-correction from 그녀 to honorific 그분 signals a revered superior without identifying or gendering that figure.
findings.replacement: Everything was proceeding exactly as she—or rather, the one above her—desired.
findings.source: 모든 것은 그녀가, 아니 그분이 원하는 방향으로 흘러가고 있었다.

findings.current: “Dipping is the correct culture… No, forget that. Just keep dunking their heads in and pulling them out until I tell you to stop.”
findings.defect: “The correct culture” is an unnatural literal calque that obscures the deadpan reference to the Korean dip-versus-pour food debate.
findings.rationale: “The civilized way” conveys 올바른 문화 as a mock-cultural judgment while retaining the interrupted joke and instructions.
findings.replacement: “Dipping is the civilized way… No, forget that. Just keep dunking their heads in and pulling them out until I tell you to stop.”
findings.source: 찍먹은 올바른 문화……가 아니라, 그냥 제가 멈추라고 할 때까지 계속 머리통만 담갔다가 빼 주시면 됩니다.

findings.defect: The draft misreads the anticlimactic vocalization 에게? as a grammatical question about a recipient.
findings.rationale: The narration explicitly describes a deflated sound prompted by the tiny fragment, not a question meaning “to me.”

findings.current: The terrifying aura of a slaughter demon transformed into the appearance of the Divine Physician’s Disciple and a cheerful young physician-in-training in an instant.
findings.defect: The draft changes the subject from Mungyeong, the Slaughter Saint, into an aura and replaces his established title with the generic “slaughter demon.”
findings.rationale: 살성 is Mungyeong’s established title and the person himself performs the rapid change of persona.
findings.replacement: The terrifying Slaughter Saint transformed into the Divine Physician’s Disciple—a cheerful young physician-in-training—in an instant.
findings.source: 무시무시한 살성이 신의의 제자이자 밝은 소년 의생의 모습으로 변하는 것은 순식간이었다.

findings.current:
“Black Dragon Armor?”

“I read about it in an old secret history.
findings.defect: Taekyung’s response asking whether Mungyeong knew the armor by a different name is omitted.
findings.rationale: The omitted question motivates Mungyeong’s explanation that the armor has no fixed name.
findings.replacement:
“Black Dragon Armor?”

“Why? Is that different from the name you knew?”

“I read about it in an old secret history.

“왜, 알고 있던 이름이랑 달라?”

“오래된 비사(祕史)에서 읽은 적이 있습니다.

findings.defect: The draft turns Mungyeong’s startled, outraged reaction into a neutral silence.
findings.rationale: The exclamation mark is a pragmatic cue showing that Taekyung’s blunt retort catches Mungyeong off guard.
findings.replacement:
“You’re speaking casually to me right now too, you bastard.”

“…!”

“Oh. Sorry.”

findings.rationale: The source marks Mungyeong as sharply taken aback rather than merely silent.
findings.replacement:

이거 은근히 재밌네.

findings.defect: The draft changes Mungyeong’s puzzled reaction into undifferentiated silence.
findings.rationale: The question mark preserves his confusion at Taekyung’s apparently contradictory statement before the logout reveal.
findings.replacement:

summary: Several factual and characterization issues remain, including a wrong time unit, an altered institutional quantity, an omitted line, and a subject/title substitution.
